source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 14
statement: A change record and a staging slot are ignorable with must-understand (SNP-27, SNP-28); a change's operations stay strict (CTL-53). An approval records whose it was (APR-9): one an earlier release recorded says nothing and does not count; a rewrite by a release that does not know the member drops it, which narrows.
guards: compat:RecordCompatTest#each version reads and writes back the record the other wrote, unchanged
compat:RecordCompatTest#a later member without crit is dropped by a rewrite, which leaves the same record
compat:RecordCompatTest#a record whose crit names a member a version does not know is refused by it
compat:RecordCompatTest#an approval says whose it was, and one recorded before kinds says nothing
